LESSON: READING SYLLABLES READING

Grade: PP2
Subject: LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 3
Topic 3.7: Reading syllables READING

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Reading syllables READING. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: What activities would of class. enhance the learner’s ability to read syllables?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Read syllables in and out da, ma
2. Demonstrate ability to read • Learners could be syllables in class. encouraged to read syllabuses

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Read syllables in and out da, ma
   In simple words: practise until you can read syllables in and out da, ma. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Demonstrate ability to read • Learners could be syllables in class. encouraged to read syllabuses
   In simple words: practise until you can demonstrate ability to read • Learners could be syllables in class. encouraged to read syllabuses. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Reading syllables READING using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Reading syllables READING in the examples.
2. Explain Reading syllables READING to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Reading syllables READING.
4. Show that you can: Read syllables in and out da, ma

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading syllables READING using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Reading syllables READING important for a PP2 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Be syllables in class. encouraged to read syllabuses c) Enjoy participating in
2. Be activities that involve introduced to different reading syllables. consonants and guided to master reading syllables relating to all letters.
3. Practise reading syllables in pairs and small groups.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Read syllables in and out da, ma
2. Demonstrate ability to read • Learners could be syllables in class. encouraged to read syllabuses
